# /mandao-story

<!-- mandao:generated by npm run diagrams from core/commands/story.md; do not edit below -->

Create or enrich a user story with enough business context: sufficiency rubric, sources, AC-n with critical flags.

<picture>
  <source media="(prefers-color-scheme: dark)" srcset="../diagrams/command-story-dark.svg">
  <img alt="/mandao-story: steps, approval and what it writes" src="../diagrams/command-story-light.svg">
</picture>

## Usage

```
/mandao-story [ref] [--from <file>] [--intake <proposal#I-n>]
```

| Argument | Required / default | What it is |
|---|---|---|
| `<ref>` | optional | A tracker id or URL, or a one-line idea; empty to choose |
| `--from <file>` | optional | A long requirements document (Markdown or PDF): proposes the stories it holds, grouped in specs |
| `--intake <proposal#I-n>` | optional | Open one story of an intake proposal as a spec |

## Examples

- `/mandao-story PROJ-123` — a story from your tracker item
- `/mandao-story let customers save a cart for later` — a story from one line
- `/mandao-story --from docs/requirements.pdf` — a proposal of stories from a document
- `/mandao-story --intake docs/product/intake/requirements.md#I-2` — opens story I-2 of that proposal

## Reads

- `.mandao/sources.yml`
- `docs/constitution/`

## Writes

- `specs/<ID>-<slug>/story.md`
- `docs/product/intake/<doc>-<date>.md`

## Steps

0. From a document
1. Find or create the story
2. Sufficiency rubric
3. Write story.md
3b. UI mock (only when offered)
4. Approve (you approve)

## Approval

Yes: it stops for your approval.

## Scripts (no tokens)

- `mandao run next`
- `mandao run spec-new`
- `mandao run trace`
- `mandao run event`
- `mandao run mock-offer`
- `mandao run intake-extract`
- `mandao run intake-check`
- `mandao run intake-story`
- `mandao run intake-open`
- `mandao run intake-answer`

Paths are the defaults; `paths` in `.mandao/config.yml` can change them.
